scc-fbn.notes: Read in a browser on 2026-10-31. Online filing is also available in the Clerk-Recorder's Self-Service portal. Within 45 days after filing, the statement must be published (B&P 17917). Expires five years after filing, or 40 days after a change in facts. Corporations, LLCs, LPs and LLPs need proof of registration with the Secretary of State.
